more_info.overview: Potassium persulphate, also called potassium peroxydisulphate, is an inorganic oxidising salt. The specified chemical contains potassium and the peroxydisulphate ion, distinguishing it from ordinary potassium sulphate. It is a white solid whose dissolution increases with warmer water. The dataset retains a historical flour-treatment classification. A current human-food use for this exact preparation was not confirmed.
